latest_cos_commentary.headline: Loyalty specialist competes through broad digital-ordering integrations rather than POS replacement.
latest_cos_commentary.genius_exposure: Loyalty specialist competes through broad digital-ordering integrations rather than POS replacement.
latest_cos_commentary.competitive_timing: Thanx reported that its ordering integration footprint tripled in 2026 and expanded loyalty controls in its July product update. Latest check: Thanx’s August update says its ordering runs on Deliverect middleware for multi-location brands.
latest_cos_commentary.sales_response: Benchmark loyalty activation and incremental frequency against the actual ordering stack at each prospect.
latest_cos_commentary.risk_and_uncertainty: The July page gives a month but no confirmed day; source_date represents month only. Product availability does not establish rollout to all Thanx customers; release gives month only.
